contributions.detail: exact - 2 rows sum to 3,500.00 = the filer's own hand-placed Amount-column total on p2 AND the cover's promoted figure. ⚠ PRECEDENT NOTE, deliberately NOT flagged in_kind: BOTH rows are labelled by the filer '(in kind contribution)' inside the Name of Contributor cell, and BOTH are INSIDE the 3,500.00 the filer totalled and the cover states. That is the OPPOSITE of the McKenna-2024 shape the brief cites (a separate in-kind schedule with its own total, excluded from a monetary-only cover). Setting in_kind=true here would make build_finance report itemized_contrib_sum=0.00 against a stated 3,500.00 and publish a false non-reconciliation, so the flag is withheld and the fact is carried verbatim instead: the '(in kind contribution)' text is preserved inside donor_raw on both rows and named in each row note. This filing's ENTIRE stated contribution total is in-kind; there is no monetary contribution on the page.

expenditures.detail: delta 152.67 - FILER ARITHMETIC, traced to the row on the page. The 17 vendor rows sum to 2,226.44; the filer's own boxed 'Total amount of expenditures $2,073.77' (printed twice on p3, and matching the cover) is exactly 152.67 lower, which is exactly line 1 (3/18/22 PC Print Ink (reimburse Cind..., Yard Signs and Stickers, $152.67) - the first data row, omitted from her addition. Every amount in the column was re-read at 600 dpi as a tight crop of the Amount column and reproduces; the PC Print Ink row carries no strike-through, no annotation and no 'void' mark, so nothing on the page says the row was withdrawn. The stated figure is the form's own printed total and is not recomputed.

Both printed specimen rows (8/25/10 'Jon and Jane Doe' $435.00 on p2, 8/25/10 'Name of Business' $512.00 on p3) survive on the page and are excluded; the totals close only without them.

geometry.basis: rule-detection row banding (rowbands.py) on the page's own printed grid; box spans the full table width of the row

_meta_itemized.notes: ⚠ SOURCE PROPERTY THE CONTRACT DOES NOT ANTICIPATE - BOTH LEDGER PAGES ARE SCANNED 90 DEGREES ROTATED. Pages 2 and 3 are portrait (613x790 pt, /Rotate 0) but the landscape form was fed sideways, so a printed table ROW is a VERTICAL strip in the rendered page, not a horizontal band. rowbands.py's horizontal projection therefore measures the table's COLUMN separators (and text lines) as 'bands' - p2 reports 56, p3 41 - while the table's real row separators come back as the VERTICAL rules. A `band` index would resolve through geometry_for() to a horizontal strip that does NOT contain the row it names, and the declared-frame formula (x,w fixed; y varying with band) cannot express a vertical strip either. Rather than store a box that does not contain its row, these rows carry `page` only and geometry is HONESTLY ABSENT. The measurement itself exists and is recorded here so the coordinator can regenerate it if the geometry model gains a rotation flag: p2 rows are vertical strips at x_pct = 19.96 + (k-1)*2.413, width 2.413, spanning y_pct 23.1-91.7, with k=1 header, k=2 specimen, k=3 blank, k=4 Donna Urban, k=5 Gary Urban, k=6 blank, k=7 the 3,500.00 total; p3 rows are at x_pct = 31.94 + (k-1)*2.4125, width 2.4125, spanning y_pct 29.6-90.2, with k=1 header, k=2 specimen, k=3 blank, k=4..15 the first twelve vendors in order, k=16 blank, k=17..21 the last five vendors, k=22 blank, k=23 the 2,073.77 total. Those strips were spot-verified end to end: pct:39.06,55.0,2.47,40.0@p3 reproduces '3/18/22 | PC Print Ink (reimburse Cind | Yard Signs and Stickers' and pct:27.8,40.0,2.2,27.0@p2 lands on the Donna Urban address cell. ADDRESSES: the Mailing Address cells of both donor rows are blank except for faint residual character fragments in the middle of the cell (visible at 1200 dpi), and the Zipcode cells are entirely empty - the pattern of the county's white-out redaction of the 2022 Pre-Election copies (the same treatment as Furse 20651), not an empty column typed by the filer; the specimen row's own address ('PO Box 128, Coalville, UT' / 84017) survives untouched, which is what a county redaction of REAL donor addresses would leave behind. donor_city/donor_state are honestly BLANK on both rows either way. TWO CELLS ARE CLIPPED BY THEIR OWN COLUMN in print, not by this transcription: the p3 vendor 'PC Print Ink (reimburse Cind' and the p3 purpose '(1/2) Water, Ice, Balloons, Carrots for Campaign Kic' both run into the neighbouring cell's text and stop mid-word on the page; they are stored exactly as printed and never completed. The 2022 sheet prints no City/State column at all. The cover's slashed-zero balance is a known cover-side property (2026-08-02 zero-glyph pass) and was not touched. RESOLVED 2026-08-14 (resume agent 3): make_itemized_caches.py gained an explicit per-side `table_frame.<side>.transposed` mode which bands the page by its VERTICAL rules and takes the y-extent from the horizontal ones, so these rows now carry MEASURED geometry from the page's own printed grid instead of none. Band indices verified end-to-end by make_snippet --value render-back (the default --row mode is USELESS on a transposed page: it forces x,w=0,100 and returns the whole page): p2 b4=Donna Urban $1,750.00, p3 b4=PC Print Ink $152.67, p3 b15=Denise's $22.98, p3 b17=Amazon $10.73, p3 b21=State Liquor Store $122.36. On both pages band 1=header, band 2=the printed SPECIMEN row (dropped), band 3=blank; p3 carries a further blank row at band 16 between Denise's and Amazon, which is why lines 13-17 map to bands 17-21.
